text:
incident-bot: PAGER -> P1 incident for tenant AcmeCorp: increased websocket disconnects and repeated client retries observed through their VPC gateway. Symptoms: server-side 1006 closes, spikes in 504 at gateway, and repeated reconnect loops. Paging eng-oncall. Please ack and triage.

mike: acked. I'm oncall. Pulling logs now. Any immediate CS notes?

rachel (CS): Acme reports UX freezes for their streaming editor. They're seeing reconnects ~every 10-20s. Affects ~60% of sessions in EU region. Customer impact: degraded realtime collaboration, they may throttle traffic if not mitigated.

dinesh: I see a pattern in gateway logs: upstream gRPC streams timing out after 30s, then gateway retries 3x, clients treat it as fatal and reconnect. Stack: customer app -> Acme private gateway -> our enterprise VPC gateway -> dedicated pool (gpu-dedicated-eu-2).

mike: good summary. Can someone paste the relevant gateway log snippet?

ben: pasted snippet below
```
2026-03-14T09:12:34.123Z INFO gw[acme-01] stream_open session=abcd1234
2026-03-14T09:12:64.987Z WARN gw[acme-01] upstream_timeout session=abcd1234 duration=30s
2026-03-14T09:12:65.001Z INFO gw[acme-01] retrying_upstream session=abcd1234 attempt=1
2026-03-14T09:12:75.005Z ERROR gw[acme-01] stream_closed session=abcd1234 code=1006 reason="upstream EOF"
```

ben: also seeing an increase in cumulative KV cache misses on the runtime for that pool (~40% increase).

karen (support): Acme is asking for ETA. They mentioned they can flip to their fallback region but that impacts latency for EU users.

mike: quick mitigation options: 1) increase upstream timeout on enterprise gateway for Acme to 90s (fast), 2) temporarily route Acme traffic to a warm spare dedicated pool in us-west (longer), 3) apply a gateway-level retry-backoff (reduce immediate retries). I prefer (1) + (3) short term. Thoughts?

dinesh: Agree. The 30s is our default. Their workload sometimes has long-run tokens when context windows are big. Increasing to 90s should stop premature upstream termination. Also will patch gateway to send 2xx to clients on retryable transient to avoid client reconnection churn.

mike: can we do (1) without full deploy? i.e., dynamic config change per-tenant?

dinesh: yes, we have tenant config overrides in the control plane. I'll apply override for tenant acme-corp: {"upstream_timeout_secs":90, "retry_policy":{"max_retries":1, "per_try_timeout":60, "backoff_ms":500}}

mike: please post exact command you run so I can monitor.

dinesh: running:
```
redwoodctl gateway set-config --tenant acme-corp --upstream-timeout 90 --retry-max 1 --retry-backoff 500 --region eu
```

deploy-bot: config-change-started: gateway-config/acme-corp override by dinesh at 2026-03-14T09:18:02Z

ben: monitoring metrics for drops and 1006s now.

mike: heads-up for handoff in 30m to evening oncall. If this stabilizes, we'll do postmortem with mitigation timeline.

customer-support: Notified Acme that we're applying a non-disruptive config change to increase upstream timeout and reduce retry aggressiveness. Asking them to hold off fallback region change for 10m.

~10m later~

ben: metrics update: 1006 closes down 85% over last 5m, gateway 504s dropped from 22% -> 3% for acme-corp in eu. KV cache miss rate steady.

rachel (CS): Acme reports reconnects have stopped in a sample of sessions. They're running a smoke test and will confirm after ~15m.

mike: good. I'm going to reduce alert noise and keep the channel open. If anything creeps back, page.

~20m later - before handoff~

deploy-bot: config-change-complete: gateway-config/acme-corp override applied successfully at 2026-03-14T09:40:31Z

mike: preparing handoff to night oncall @dinesh will remain point for 30m, then handoff to ben (night). ben, any questions?

ben: I'll take it. I'll keep dashboards open and enable a short-lived elevated sampling on streams for acme-corp. Also will watch token-per-second to ensure no regression.

mike: summary for postmortem: root cause likely default upstream timeout + bursty long-token requests from Acme's editor. Mitigation: tenant override to 90s timeout + reduce gateway retry aggressiveness to avoid reconnect loops. Follow-ups: add automated detection when gateway 1006 rate > X% to auto-escalate tenant overrides, and investigate KV cache miss spike.

rachel (CS): Acme is satisfied with fix so far and will monitor from their side. They asked for a summary email, I'll draft and send.

karen (support): I'll schedule a follow-up with Acme tomorrow to discuss long-term options (dedicated warm spare, app-side exponential backoff).

customer-support: Customer notified and will confirm tomorrow if any residual issues.

mike: closing pager for now. If anything reoccurs reopen a new thread and page. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: incident P1 acknowledged -> resolved (stabilized) at 2026-03-14T10:06:28Z
